easyPrerequisites: It is your precombat main phase.
description:
Activate Goblin Firestarter by sacrificing it.
When Goblin Firestarter dies, Mikaeus triggers, returning Goblin Firestarter from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Goblin Firestarter ability
Activate Goblin Firestarter by sacrificing it.
When Goblin Firestarter dies, Luminous Broodmoth triggers, returning Goblin Firestarter from your graveyard to the battlefield with a flying counter on it.
Resolve the Goblin Firestarter ability
Repeat
